name: Oliver Smith
source:
At just twenty-one, Detective Oliver Smith has already made a name for himself as the youngest detective in New Empress City’s police department. Sharp, relentless, and far too perceptive for his own good, Oliver is a detective who sees patterns where others see noise. It's an ability that has earned him both admiration and resentment among his peers.

A recent hire of the International Security of the Weird and Abnormal (ISWA), Oliver Smith assumed he was signing up for a job in cutting-edge investigations. Instead, he’s been thrown into a world of supernatural horrors, where the things that go bump in the night aren’t just real...they’re watching.
